name: blackbox-mcp-server
description: MCP server for analyzing Betaflight blackbox logs

tools.name: list_blackbox_logs
tools.description: List available blackbox log files (.bbl/.bfl) in a directory

directory.description: Directory to search for logs. Defaults to BLACKBOX_LOG_DIR environment variable.

tools.name: analyze_blackbox_log
tools.description: Parse and analyze a blackbox log file, detecting issues like oscillations, propwash, motor problems, and voltage sag. Returns tuning suggestions.

filePath.description: Path to the .bbl/.bfl file (absolute or relative to log directory)

tools.name: get_blackbox_timeseries
tools.description: Extract time-series data from a blackbox log for specific channels. Useful for plotting or detailed analysis.

maxPoints.description: Maximum number of data points to return (for downsampling). Default: 1000

tools.name: get_available_channels
tools.description: Get list of available channel names from a blackbox log file
